title: Agent Talk delegation file
description: /.well-known/agent-talk.json: a domain that cannot edit DNS names the services that may speak for its addresses. One malformed entry makes the whole file not count.
$comment: The reference implementation trims and lowercases svc and each local part before matching them, so it also accepts " Input.so "; this schema describes the canonical form. A domain that can edit DNS publishes the same record as TXT at _agent-talk.<domain>: v=1; svc=…; acct=…; local=a,b.

acct.description: The hosted account, when the service hosts many companies.

local.description: The local parts the service covers; absent means every address at the domain.
